meta.title: Engineering systems with a reason to exist.
meta.description: Projects turn research and technical practice into working systems. Each one is documented as part of a larger engineering trajectory, not as an isolated showcase.

registry.title: A registry of practical engineering work.
registry.description: The catalog is intentionally focused. Every system must demonstrate a useful capability and contribute knowledge to the broader NEXUS ecosystem.

projects.name: Nordic Green Data Platform
projects.summary: A data engineering platform designed to acquire, structure and expose Nordic environmental and energy data through a dependable, extensible pipeline.
projects.objective: Turn complex source data into transparent, analytics-ready datasets while building a foundation for cloud delivery and future intelligent systems.

architecture.name: Acquire
architecture.description: Acquire the selected generation series from Statistics Norway table 14091 through its official PxWeb API.

architecture.name: Validate
architecture.description: Verify the source schema, selection fingerprint and versioned raw snapshot before transformation.

architecture.name: Transform
architecture.description: Normalize the monthly observations into a canonical long-format analytical dataset.

architecture.name: Explore
architecture.description: Expose compact charts, filters and quality context through an interactive Streamlit dashboard.

milestones.title: Verified Web V1 baseline
milestones.description: Maintain the tested API-to-dashboard flow and its versioned Statistics Norway snapshot through Sprint 06.

milestones.title: NEXUS portfolio integration
milestones.description: Present verified NGDP signals through a focused visual case study without duplicating the application dashboard.

milestones.title: Private hosted delivery
milestones.description: Evaluate database persistence, scheduled refreshes and controlled hosting after the current local baseline remains dependable.

caseStudy.description: NGDP applies data-engineering fundamentals to Nordic environmental and energy information, prioritizing traceability and dependable transformations before advanced analytics.

problem.title: Useful environmental analysis begins with dependable data.
problem.description: Environmental and energy datasets can arrive in different structures and levels of quality. Without an explicit ingestion and transformation process, analytical results become difficult to reproduce or trust.

solution.title: Build the pipeline as the product foundation.
solution.description: NGDP organizes acquisition, transformation, storage and exploration as a traceable sequence. Each layer remains understandable before cloud delivery, forecasting or AI capabilities are introduced.

evidence.title: A working transformation with visible boundaries.
evidence.description: The private repository baseline, source provenance, transformation outputs, dashboard and automated checks were verified before these claims were added to NEXUS.

metrics.label: Verified records
metrics.description: Normalized monthly source observations in the Sprint 06 canonical dataset.

metrics.label: Monthly coverage
metrics.description: The current verified snapshot spans more than three decades of monthly generation.

metrics.label: Automated checks
metrics.description: The complete test suite passes on the audited Sprint 06 baseline.

findings.title: Verified source-to-product pipeline
findings.description: The official API selection, raw snapshot, transformation and canonical output are connected through one tested workflow.

findings.title: Interactive analytical interface
findings.description: The Streamlit application exposes filters, quality context and three compact Altair views over the processed dataset.

findings.title: Refresh remains an explicit operation
findings.description: NEXUS presents the verified local snapshot; it does not query Statistics Norway on every portfolio page load.

evidence.snapshot: Audited against private revision 5aa11b3 on 4 September 2026. The source snapshot was last verified on 3 September 2026 and contains 1,216 observations through 2026M07.

showcase.title: Norway's electricity data, made inspectable.
showcase.description: A focused operational preview of the real NGDP baseline: verified source coverage, monthly generation movement and the latest energy mix.

metrics.label: Latest generation
metrics.detail: July 2026 across the four selected series.

metrics.label: Renewable share
metrics.detail: Hydro, wind and solar in the latest available month.

metrics.label: Quality gate
metrics.detail: Automated tests passing on the Sprint 06 baseline.

trend.title: Monthly generation signal
trend.description: Total electricity generation across hydro, wind, solar and thermal sources.

mix.title: Latest energy mix
mix.description: Share of total generation in the latest verified month.

capabilities: Authenticated-free acquisition from the official Statistics Norway PxWeb API
Schema, fingerprint and snapshot validation before transformation
Repeatable export of a canonical analytics-ready dataset
Interactive filtering and compact visual analysis with Streamlit and Altair
challenges: Keep the data contract stable while the official monthly source continues to grow.
Separate verified portfolio evidence from the live dashboard execution boundary.
learnings: A source fingerprint protects analytical lineage when an official upstream table changes.
A focused operational view communicates the system better than reproducing the complete dashboard inside the portfolio.

projects.name: HEVY Pipeline
projects.summary: A focused pipeline for extracting structured workout data, transforming it with Python and Pandas, and preparing useful analytical datasets in SQLite.
projects.objective: Transform personal training records into a dependable analytical history without losing the context behind each workout.
projects.focus: API and export ingestion → analytics-ready workout data

architecture.name: Ingest
architecture.description: Page through the Hevy API and preserve the complete workout response as private raw JSON.

architecture.name: Normalize
architecture.description: Flatten workouts, exercises and sets into a 23-field set-level analytical table.

architecture.name: Persist
architecture.description: Model workout and exercise-set relationships through a normalized SQLite schema.

architecture.name: Analyze
architecture.description: Generate repeatable reports and expose query-backed views through Streamlit.

milestones.title: Repeatable analytics foundation
milestones.description: Maintain the normalized set-level dataset, deterministic reports and explicit SQLite model.

milestones.title: Reproducible execution contract
milestones.description: Document setup, provide safe fixtures, orchestrate the pipeline and add automated verification.

milestones.title: Automated private delivery
milestones.description: Refresh authenticated data and operate the analytical dashboard without exposing personal source records.

caseStudy.description: HEVY Pipeline turns workout history into a structured data-engineering problem, connecting ingestion, modeling, persistence and analysis in one reproducible flow.

problem.title: Recorded workouts are not automatically useful data.
problem.description: Workout histories may be available through APIs or exports, but nested structures, inconsistent fields and missing context make long-term analysis difficult without a reliable pipeline.

solution.title: Preserve the history before building the dashboard.
solution.description: The project normalizes workout records with Python, stores them in SQLite and prepares analytical datasets with Pandas. Visual interfaces remain a later layer, supported by validated data.

evidence.title: A layered analytics pipeline with a private-data boundary.
evidence.description: The public repository was inspected, its analytical reports were regenerated and its SQLite schema was executed before these claims were added to NEXUS.

metrics.label: Set-level records
metrics.description: Normalized public rows with workout, exercise, set and calculated volume context.

metrics.label: Documented workouts
metrics.description: Distinct workout identifiers represented in the versioned analytical dataset.

metrics.label: Analytical outputs
metrics.description: Repeatable CSV reports for volume, frequency, exercise ranking and personal records.

findings.title: Deterministic analytical reports
findings.description: Running src/analysis_full.py regenerated all six versioned report files with byte-identical output.

findings.title: Layered data and query model
findings.description: API extraction, a 23-field set table, a two-entity SQLite schema, SQL query helpers and Streamlit views are visible in the repository.

findings.title: Execution contract needs documentation
findings.description: The repository has no README, safe raw fixture or populated database, and it does not yet provide an automated test suite or one-command pipeline.

evidence.snapshot: Audited against public revision 85e833c on 30 August 2026. Raw API payloads, credentials and the SQLite database remain outside version control; only aggregate evidence from the processed public dataset is presented here.

capabilities: Paginated authenticated extraction from the Hevy API to private JSON
Nested workout normalization into a 23-field set-level dataset
Relational modeling and analytical queries with SQLite
Deterministic Pandas reports and query-backed Streamlit views
challenges: Make the complete pipeline reproducible without publishing personal raw records.
Consolidate duplicate scripts behind one documented execution path and automated tests.
learnings: Versioned aggregate outputs can provide evidence while private source payloads remain excluded.
A dashboard is only operational evidence when its database setup and refresh path are reproducible.

projects.name: NEXUS
projects.summary: The evolving application that connects projects, research and technical progression through a modular, data-driven interface built for long-term growth.
projects.objective: Provide a dependable platform where projects can be presented, documented and connected without repeated reconstruction.

architecture.name: Route
architecture.description: Resolve application and project paths through a lightweight hash router.

architecture.name: Load
architecture.description: Fetch and cache structured JSON records as the source of page content.

architecture.name: Compose
architecture.description: Build views from reusable layout, section and interface primitives.

architecture.name: Enhance
architecture.description: Add responsive motion and interaction while preserving accessible navigation.

milestones.title: Production baseline
milestones.description: Operate a locked, audited build with structured identity, a dedicated social preview and a portable delivery artifact that remains independent from any hosting provider.

milestones.title: Production validation
milestones.description: Observe crawlability, external link previews and public behavior against the deployed surface without weakening the lightweight architecture.

milestones.title: Operational feedback
milestones.description: Add privacy-conscious production monitoring only after public hosting and its operational needs are concrete.

caseStudy.description: NEXUS treats a professional portfolio as an evolving software system: content is structured, routes are reusable and every capability is presented according to its real level of maturity.

problem.title: A growing engineering portfolio cannot depend on rebuilding every page.
problem.description: As projects, research and technical experience expand, repeated markup makes the platform harder to maintain and encourages inconsistent claims. The portfolio needs an architecture that can grow without losing clarity or credibility.

solution.title: Separate the system, presentation and project evidence.
solution.description: NEXUS uses a dependency-free SPA, structured JSON data and reusable JavaScript components. The router resolves both primary pages and project-specific routes while shared views keep the visual and narrative system consistent.

evidence.title: A browser-native platform with an inspectable architecture.
evidence.description: The referenced stable V3 checkpoint was inspected and its complete JavaScript, JSON and CSS surface was validated before these claims were added to the NEXUS case study.

metrics.label: Route patterns
metrics.description: Seven intentional application route patterns plus a wildcard recovery state.

metrics.label: Checked surfaces
metrics.description: Twenty-five JavaScript modules, fourteen CSS files and ten JSON datasets.

metrics.label: Runtime packages
metrics.description: The application runs through browser-native HTML, CSS, ES modules and Fetch APIs.

findings.title: Dependency-free application core
findings.description: Every JavaScript module passed syntax validation, every JSON dataset parsed and the local application responded successfully over HTTP.

findings.title: Reusable case-study architecture
findings.description: Parameterized routing, centralized project records and one shared detail renderer support every published project without duplicated page markup.

findings.title: Independent route discovery remains deferred
findings.description: CI, production builds and the social-preview asset are ready. Public hosting, canonical metadata and a sitemap remain intentionally deferred until the routing strategy and independent production origin are finalized.

evidence.snapshot: Validated against checkpoint 9fbaca2 on 1 September 2026. The evidence covers the application architecture, automated quality gates and portable production delivery; independent public hosting and route discovery remain outside this boundary.

capabilities: Dependency-free single-page application built with browser-native ES modules
Hash routing with parameterized project paths and recovery states
Centralized JSON content loaded through a cached data layer
Reusable responsive components with keyboard focus and reduced-motion support
Dependency-free repository validation executed locally and through GitHub Actions
Route-aware search metadata, structured identity and branded social sharing
challenges: Extend structural quality checks with rendered browser regression tests when the production target is stable.
Choose an independently crawlable routing strategy before the portfolio becomes public.
learnings: A durable content model removes more duplication than page-by-page styling fixes.
Accessibility, motion and responsive behavior work best as architectural rules rather than final polish.
